items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Nat came over several times and he actually had me play with him in Boston when Jimmy Cobb couldn’t... I played a few nights, and I was fourteen.

ctx.x: And was it mostly swing-based jazz that you were hearing?
I think a lot of times it was blues based jazz, like organ trios, Gene Ammons, Cannonball, that kind of stuff. My father really, his style of playing is Gene Ammons is a big influence on him.
